def check(candidate):

    # Check some simple cases
    assert candidate('[[]]') == True, "This prints if this assert fails 1 (good for debugging!)"
    assert candidate('[]]]]]]][[[[[]') == False
    assert candidate('[][]') == False
    assert candidate(('[]')) == False
    assert candidate('[[[[]]]]') == True
    assert candidate('[]]]]]]]]]]') == False
    assert candidate('[][][[]]') == True
    assert candidate('[[]') == False
    assert candidate('[]]') == False
    assert candidate('[[]][[') == True
    assert candidate('[[][]]') == True

    # Check some edge cases that are easy to work out by hand.

    assert candidate('[[[[[[[[') == False
